data.explanation: This is an invoice for a purchase on account (Kauf auf Rechnung). Pay €89.99 to the IBAN shown, using the invoice number as the payment reference. The deadline is 14 days from the invoice date, shown by the app. It appears to be already past or very close, so pay promptly if you haven't, to avoid reminders and fees. The goods remain the seller's property until paid. Keep the invoice as a receipt for warranty or returns.
